insights.summary: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue rose 38.7% to ₹285.5 Cr and PAT 80.1% to ₹63.3 Cr (H1 EBITDA margin 27.0%). Order book is about ₹2,010 Cr. Two new facilities, the Global Coil Factory in Sangli and the PCS plant in Turkey, began operating in October, ahead of the December 2026 date given earlier for the Turkish plant. The WS Insulators acquisition is still to complete.
